status: Direct poles and centroids jointly selected from per-descriptor median autotune tails; unit-normalized CLIP text embeddings

descriptor_table.rationale: Moran slides 9-10: short, varied visual descriptions with emotional/contextual associations. D1/D3 technical or visual, D2 perceptual, D4 cultural/associative. The v14 brightness banks retain high-response constructions and explicitly use very, much, and extreme intensity language for both near-white and near-black targets. Engineering-authored, not human-validated.
descriptor_table.strength_revision: Both brightness poles emphasize very, much, and extreme overexposure or underexposure; other banks unchanged.
